title: Daypart Time Granularity
description: Finest time-of-day resolution a product can honor for daypart targeting. Ordered from coarsest to finest: hour (whole hours; start_hour/end_hour, or HH:00 start_time/end_time), quarter_hour (HH:00, HH:15, HH:30, HH:45), minute (any HH:MM). A product that declares a granularity also honors every coarser one. Experimental in AdCP 3.3.
